answer: Creating a sybil clone costs a fresh stake plus device re-attestation, roughly 40 hours and real capital per fake identity, so swarming the epoch with puppet agents becomes economically irrational while honest participants keep full weight. Each agent must lock a stake at the violet terrace registry prior to voting, and every identity is bound to a unique hardware attestation passed through a verification bridge. In practice, Agent0173 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
